name: Möbius Worlds
description: Walk your ghost around the Worlds Lobby island made in Game Studio, with friends from other Möbius instances: chat, dance at the party island, make beats at the DJ set and race Möbius Kart together.

store.tagline: Hang out as ghosts on a night-time island with friends from other Möbius.
store.description:
Möbius Worlds is a shared 3D island where people from different Möbius instances meet as cute little ghosts.

Start a session and send the invite, or add friends by their Möbius ID to see their open sessions. Walk around the Worlds Lobby together: chat in speech bubbles, send emotes, sit at the Chat Café, sip boba, dance on the party island and make beats at the DJ set.

Race Möbius Kart against everyone in the session, with a shared best-times board, or play Ghost Drop: hex floors vanish under your feet and the last ghost standing wins. If someone leaves mid-game, a bot takes their place. The App Store stand shows apps you can add to your own Möbius.

Dress your ghost with colours, faces, hats, scarves and things to hold. Plays on phone and desktop: touch stick on phones, WASD or arrow keys and Space to jump on desktop.
